digest.component_or_area: Jira create and binding lifecycle coordinator
propositions: Create operation must execute pending-binding intent durably before any provider call to prevent zero-key local orphans and enable recovery without blind replay.

After Jira returns a key, the canonical rebar-id label must be attached first, entity property added as optional enrichment, then persisted through RP-02 facade with known-key safety abort on any failure.
Create timeout or connection-loss cases must never blind-replay; replay-safe identity observation or deferred pending record prevents duplicate issue creation across restart.

Lifecycle intents dependent on create (links, children, hierarchy) must wait for proven remote postcondition while tombstones, filters, read-only modes, and create-before-link ordering remain enforced.
Keyed recovery performs zero search; keyless negative search enforces both three-miss and 3600-second conjunction; per-entry recovery failure does not block unrelated ticket convergence.
